== '''Overview''' ==
The Katana Devil Portal Can be Only obtained by doing Tier 5 Devil portals. Finishing a Katana Devil Portal has a chance to give the [[Denjy]] secret unit.

== Obtaining + Rewards ==
'''A Katana Devil Portal has a slight chance to  be obtained when using Tier 5 Devil Portals, which will replace said portal.'''
* The drop chance for the secret unit in a Katana Devil Portal is of 100% for the host and 5% for other players who enter the portal
* These portals are currently unobtainable and have been since [[Update Log#Update%2012%20-%20My%20Hero%20Academia%20Update|Update 12 - My Hero Academia Update]]
